assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known unspecified atrial fibrillation
mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to evaluate for arrhythmic burden and optimize anticoagulation management
The service is clinically supported by the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
This elevates stroke risk and warrants continuous rhythm surveillance
The associated diagnosis codes I48.91 and Z86.73 document the underlying atrial fibrillation and relevant patient history
These codes justify medical necessity for the monitoring service
